import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):\n    left = [row[:4] for row in grid]\n    right = [row[5:9] for row in grid]\n    if all(all(a or b for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)) for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)):\n        return [[a if a else b for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)] for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]\n    return left\n'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(code)
test=[[1,1,1,1,5,2,0,0,0],[0,1,1,0,5,2,2,2,2],[0,1,1,0,5,2,0,0,0],[0,0,0,0,5,0,0,0,0]]
out=transform(test); print(out)
